newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares jump on foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares jump on foreign demand.

text.p: Slovenian shares jumped 3.89 percent on Wednesday, pushed up by increased foreign buying interest, and traders said gains may well continue until the end of the month.

"Foreign investors are definitely ready to come back, they are especially investing in pharmaceuticall and food processing industries," said Florian Hellmich, an equity analyst at Vienna-based Investmentbank Austria.
* The 10-share SBI index rose 45.9 points to 1,227.3.
* Bank SKB was the most actively traded share, firming 2.80 percent to 44,000 tolars on volume of 2,894 shares.
* Overall nine shares rose, five fell and 10 were untraded.
